content_sections.heading: IIITDM Jabalpur Research Associate (RA) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing Jabalpur
Design and development of a novel fully automated low-cost wire arc additive manufacturing set up for fabricating high strength defense and aerospace grade parts
1 Year subject to satisfactory work progress
Rs. 37,000/- p.m. + 18% HRA (If on-campus accommodation is not provided)
As per CSIR HRDG norms (35 Yrs for unreserved candidates)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Research Associate position must fulfill the educational qualifications and criteria set by the institute according to CSIR HRDG norms. Essential Qualification (a): Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering with three years R&D experience as on the last date of application, evidenced from RAship or associateship or from date of registration of PhD. Essential Qualification (b): Candidates with submitted Ph.D. (science/engineering) thesis are also eligible for RA'ship, subject to the condition that PhD viva-voce is done and they are declared qualified for the award of PhD / awarded PhD degree before the expiry of the validity of the award offer. Essential Qualification (c): The candidate must have at least one research publication in a standard refereed journal as listed in Journal Citation Reports (JCR), as per CSIR HRDG norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Associate will receive a fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus 18% HRA if on-campus accommodation is not provided. The project tenure is 1 year and is strictly subject to satisfactory work progress.

content_sections.heading: IIITDM Jabalpur Research Associate (RA) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be required to handle responsibilities related to the research project: Good knowledge in wire arc additive manufacturing Material Processing and Characterization Experimental and Analytical Study Design and Simulation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Research Associate (RA)
content_sections.text: Access the official Google application form using the provided link. Fill in all required personal, educational, and professional details accurately. Submit the completed Google form online on or before 30-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Mere eligibility does not ensure shortlisting of the candidate for the post. A higher criterion may be set depending on the number of applications received. The date and time of the interview will be notified to the shortlisted candidates through email in advance. No TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview.

rows.date: To be notified through email to shortlisted candidates

faq.question: Q1. What is the position available at IIITDM Jabalpur?
faq.answer: The institute has opened 1 vacancy for the Research Associate (RA) post under a CSIR sponsored mechanical engineering research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form via the online Google form is 30-10-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for this Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering with three years R&D experience, or have submitted their Ph.D. thesis in science/engineering along with at least one research publication in a JCR-listed standard refereed journal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly fellowship offered?
faq.answer: The selected Research Associate will receive a monthly fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- plus 18% HRA if campus accommodation is not provided.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for unreserved candidates?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for unreserved candidates, as per CSIR HRDG norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by filling out the Google application form provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. How will shortlisted candidates be informed about the interview?
faq.answer: The date and time of the interview will be notified directly to the shortlisted candidates through email in advance.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The position is temporary and purely on a contractual basis for 1 year, subject to satisfactory work progress under a time-bound CSIR sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q10. Who should candidates contact for queries regarding the position?
faq.answer: Candidates can contact the Principal Investigator, Dr. Manu Srivastava, Assistant Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering, via email at [email protected] or phone.
